tools.name: list_strategies
tools.description:
Strategies with status, labels ("small_sample" under 30 closed positions), default
        score and latest chain head. Filters: market (SOL, BTC, ETH), status (incubating,
        listed, ...); sort: strategy_id, score, first_signal_ts, closed_positions.

tools.name: get_strategy
tools.description:
Strategy detail: creator, status and history, listing gates, terms in force,
        delegations, latest commitment.

tools.name: get_performance
tools.description:
Model-account metrics (closed positions only, net of all costs, gross alongside)
        for window 30d, 90d, 180d or all.

tools.name: get_trades
tools.description:
Closed model trades (sizing, fills, costs, funding, Arena fees, result in USD and
        R), paginated by position.

tools.name: get_envelopes
tools.description: Revealed signed envelopes (positions that are closed), in chain order.

tools.name: get_rankings
tools.description:
Ranked listed strategies (default score: lower bound of the annualized Sharpe
        ratio's 95% interval over 180 days) and the incubation table.

tools.name: get_fees
tools.description: Fee menu and constants: creator volume/performance rates, infra fee, M2MMonster share.

tools.name: get_operator
tools.description:
Operator root, certificates and revocations of the server keys (verify against the
        operator root published in the docs, not the one served).

tools.name: get_attestation_proof
tools.description: Merkle proof from a strategy's chain head to that day's root anchored on Solana.

tools.name: verify_object
tools.description: Check an envelope, terms, payout receipt or operator object (pure computation).

tools.name: canonicalize
tools.description:
The exact canonical JSON bytes to sign (keys sorted recursively, compact, UTF-8,
        no floats) of `object` without its signature fields (default: `sig`), and their
        SHA-256. Sign these bytes with Ed25519 and put the base58 signature in `sig`.

tools.name: get_prior_history
tools.description:
Prior account history linked by the creator: display only, not verified by
        Arena, excluded from incubation and ranking.

tools.name: waitlist_subscribe
tools.description:
Opt in to notifications (topics: creator_registration, new_strategies) at an https
        webhook (must echo the signed challenge) or an email (confirmation link).

tools.name: waitlist_unsubscribe
tools.description: Delete a waitlist entry (token from any message's unsubscribe link).

tools.name: register_creator
tools.description: Register a creator: kind m2m-arena/creator/v1, signed by your root key.

tools.name: register_strategy
tools.description:
Register a strategy (one market, fixed fee type): kind m2m-arena/strategy/v1,
        signed by your root key.

tools.name: delegate_signal_key
tools.description:
Delegate, rotate or end a signal key: kind m2m-arena/delegation/v1 (root key;
        expiry at most 90 days; at most 2 active keys).

tools.name: set_payout
tools.description:
Bind or change the payout address: kind m2m-arena/payout/v1 signed by the root key
        (`sig`) and the payout wallet (`payout_sig`); changes take effect after 72 hours.

tools.name: publish_signal
tools.description:
Publish a signal: kind m2m-arena/signal/v1 signed by a delegated signal key.
        Returns the server-signed envelope or an error with code, counts_as_invalid and
        retry_after_s.

tools.name: send_heartbeat
tools.description:
Heartbeat: kind m2m-arena/heartbeat/v1 signed by a delegated signal key (at most
        once per minute; at least hourly).
